lead.headline: UT Martin beats Temple and keeps the OVC's top rating
lead.deck: Davi Remagen scored 31 as the Skyhawks won as home underdogs. The league went 3-9, and UT Martin is the only OVC team in our top 170.
body: UT Martin was a 2-point underdog at home against Temple on Monday and won 90-81. Davi Remagen scored 31 and Arminas Vilkas added 20. A day earlier the Skyhawks lost 78-76 at Utah Valley as 6.5-point underdogs, with 21 from Remagen. That is 52 points in two games for the player of the week.

The Skyhawks are 5-3, first in the power rankings for a second straight week and 124th in our model at plus-4.8 points per 100 possessions. Tennessee State, 171st at minus-1.0, is the only other OVC team inside our top 260. The Tigers did not play this week.

The rest of the league went 2-8. Western Illinois supplied the upset of the week, a 66-46 win at Canisius as 3.5-point underdogs, with 19 points and 12 rebounds from Jack Riley. The Leathernecks rose from ninth to seventh. A day earlier they were 6-point favorites at Mercyhurst and lost 68-65.

Eastern Illinois beat IU South Bend 83-66 behind Tanner Vogel's 21 points, 10 rebounds and five assists and 21 from Jalen Calloway. That was the league's only other win. SEMO lost 80-75 at home to Purdue Fort Wayne as a 3.5-point favorite, Lindenwood lost 63-60 at home to New Haven as a 2.5-point favorite, and SIUE lost 68-65 to Northern Illinois.

Southern Indiana dropped from sixth to eighth but covered twice. The Screaming Eagles lost 97-61 at Texas, inside a 38.5-point line, and 87-83 at VMI as 4.5-point underdogs, with 18 from Donovan Hunter.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: Three games worth your week
body: **SEMO at Kansas City, Saturday, 3 p.m.** Kansas City is favored by 2.5, and our model makes it 1.3. The total is 146. The Redhawks are 274th in our model and need something after the home loss to Purdue Fort Wayne.
**UT Martin at Eastern Kentucky, Wednesday, 7 p.m.** No line yet. UT Martin hosts Kentucky Christian on Saturday first. Remagen has 52 points in his last two games.
**Northern Illinois at Eastern Illinois, Saturday, 3 p.m.** Northern Illinois is favored by 11. The Huskies just won at SIUE by three, so the Panthers get the team that just beat SIUE.

notes.headline: Morehead State's Saturday-Sunday
notes.body: The Eagles play at Charleston Southern on Saturday night and at ETSU on Sunday afternoon. Clayton Parker had 24 points and 13 rebounds in last week's 84-61 loss at Elon.

notes.headline: Lindenwood covered at Stony Brook
notes.body: The Lions lost 69-63 at Stony Brook as 11.5-point underdogs, a day after the home loss to New Haven.

notes.headline: SEMO's two scorers
notes.body: Fontaine Williams Jr. and Alonzo Clawson-Smith had 17 each in the loss to Purdue Fort Wayne.

notes.headline: Circle it: SEMO at Kansas City
notes.body: Saturday, 3 p.m. ET on Summit League Network and Midco Sports Plus. Kansas City is a 2.5-point favorite; our model makes it 1.3. The total is 146.
